author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
After completely resorting all of the shop hardware stored in his Sortimo containers, Adam realizes the inefficiency in the final touch: the usability of the long list indexing all of the components. And based on the suggestion of viewers, he rebuilds that index into a much more practical format: a wheel!
